item.text: I’ll verify the current Mistral/Vespa CLI documentation and cite the exact pages.

Run:

```bash
mistral-vespa generate-migration <migration_name> \
  --app-dir ./vespa/migrations
```

Edit the generated migration, then deploy it:

```bash
mistral-vespa migrate \
  --app-dir ./vespa/migrations \
  --config-server http://localhost:19071 \
  --query-port 8080
```

The `migrate` command builds the application from migrations, deploys it, and waits until it is ready. [`mistral-vespa` CLI reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/cli) · [Quickstart](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/quickstart)
